title: 第886章 气鼓鼓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

大乌鸦带着五人回到万春谷主峰大殿，众人一看，皆是恍然。

“还有？”

忘忧散人问。

“嗯，在万春谷外也有，只要是主人旧识，这几日提起主人或谈论主人，应该都被曲探花盯上了。”

大乌鸦言道：“不过这应该是最后了，其他的我都已经排查过。”

“辛苦了。”韩榆微笑道。

大乌鸦便不再多言，纵身化作寻常乌鸦大小，跳上韩榆肩膀。

等到配合忘忧散人把尹长老、小海女、厉通海、陈瑛、孟豹五人身上隐患去除，大乌鸦又化作纮带垂于韩榆耳侧。

眼见这一幕，忘忧散人心下暗想：原以为韩榆这小子对灵兽过于宠溺，如今看来倒是他做对了——这大乌鸦真是从心里认他做主人。

“多谢万春谷各位，又一次退去强敌，解开危难。”

尹长老向千秋子、戚掌门、韩榆依次拱手，开口道谢。

“尹长老无需多礼。”戚掌门言道，“你我两家宗门守望相助，早已经亲如一家，说这些话反而是见外。”

免去客套后，尹长老又问：“不知这一次敌人如何，又是怎样解决？”

韩榆给孟豹一瓶练气增灵丹，一瓶灵兽丹——他有个灵兽长牙虎一直养着，用得上灵兽丹，又赠送给陈瑛、厉通海、小海女各一瓶灵石髓液。

刚好听到尹长老发问，便开口向尹长老介绍一番。

本次围困万春谷的是两个化神修士，一个被打跑了，一个被当场击杀。

听闻这消息，尹长老等几人不由神色恍惚。

化神修士被击杀了？

尹长老才金丹境界，厉通海才筑基境界……元婴修士敌人对他们来说便已经是不可抵抗的强敌，韩榆已经能击杀化神修士了？

这才过去多少年？此等情形谁能料到？

尤其是南域这地方，本来最强的也不过是金丹修士，如今连化神修士都能被南域击败、击杀了！

哪怕是一步一步、一年一年变成了这样，他们本来也不应该多么震惊——但之前被化神修士逼迫，整个南域没有反抗之力，似乎才是应该，如今真的能击杀化神修士，反而让人感觉难以置信。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The big crow led the five people back to the main peak hall of Wanchun Valley. When everyone saw it, they were all astonished.

"Any more?"

Wangyou Sanren asked.

"Well, there are also outside Wanchun Valley. As long as you are an old acquaintance of Master, if you mention or talk about Master these days, you should be targeted by Qu Tanhua."

The big crow said: "But this should be the last, I have already checked the others."

"Thank you for your hard work." Han Yu smiled.

The big crow stopped talking, turned into the size of an ordinary crow, and jumped on Han Yu's shoulder.

When they cooperated with Wangyou San to remove hidden dangers from Elder Yin, Xiao Hainv, Li Tonghai, Chen Ying, and Meng Bao, the big crow turned into a ribbon and hung down on Han Yu's ear.

Seeing this scene, Wangyousan thought to himself: He originally thought that Han Yu was too doting on the spiritual beast, but now it seems that he did the right thing - this big crow really recognized him as its master from the bottom of his heart.

"Thank you to everyone in Wanchun Valley for once again retreating the powerful enemy and relieving the crisis."

Elder Yin handed over his hands to Qian Qiuzi, Master Qi, and Han Yu in turn and said thank you.

"Elder Yin doesn't need to be polite." Headmaster Qi said, "You and our sects have been helping each other for a long time. We are already as close as one family. Saying these words is actually alienating us."

After getting rid of the politeness, Elder Yin asked again: "I wonder what happened to the enemy this time and how to deal with it?"

Han Yu gave Meng Bao a bottle of Qi training pill and a bottle of spirit beast pill - he kept a long-toothed tiger and needed the spirit beast pill. He also gave Chen Ying, Li Tonghai and Xiao Hainv each a bottle of spirit stone marrow liquid.

I happened to hear Elder Yin ask a question, so I introduced him to Elder Yin.

The people who besieged Wanchun Valley this time were two god-transformation monks. One was beaten away and the other was killed on the spot.

After hearing the news, Elder Yin and others couldn't help but look dazed.

The god-transforming monk was killed?

Elder Yin is only at the golden elixir realm, and Li Tonghai is at the foundation-building realm... The enemies of the Yuanying monks are already irresistible enemies to them. Can Han Yu already kill the god-transforming monks?

How many years has it been?Who could have predicted such a situation?

Especially in the Southern Territory, the strongest ones were originally the Golden Core cultivators, but now even the Divine Transformation cultivators can be defeated and killed by the Southern Territory!

Even if it becomes like this step by step, year by year, they shouldn't be so shocked - but before being forced by the God Transformation monks, the entire southern region had no resistance, which seems to be the right thing. Now that they can really kill the God Transformation monks, it makes people feel unbelievable.
